route_title: Asymmetric Cavity Bounds with Frozen Outer Mirrors
compilation_rationale: Coherent TMM applied to a 21-layer HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica. Layers 0–7 frozen per prior optimization. Layer 10 fixed at 200.0 nm to satisfy the 380–430 nm optical thickness constraint for HfO2 at near-infrared wavelengths. Layers 8–9 and 11–20 optimized within [100, 400] nm bounds initialized near quarter-wave values. Objectives enforce high transmittance in the 1530–1565 nm cavity passband and high reflectance in the 400–700 nm stopband, suppressing cross-band leakage. Default manufacturing tolerances applied.
